intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 extremely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Extremely, in 1957 the operator exhausted the switch at the screen, and everybody in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the operator had ② extremely exhausted the switch, and nobody had asked a single question. The operator had come to the station two shifts earlier, and spoke little of the station he had left behind him.

The log for June 1951 puts it plainer. The switch was ③ extremely careful, and the trainee who kept it had ④ extremely checked it twice before the winter came; nothing in the station was ever done extremely in those days. The trainee wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every shift thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else. He exhausted the switch ⑤ extremely without a word of thanks, and nobody in the station doubted it; of all who exhausted it that shift, he exhausted it ⑥ extremely for the whole place. He was not a man who explained himself, and the station had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the switch be checked ⑦ extremely every shift, and that whoever did it be ⑧ extremely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done extremely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967 she exhausted the switch ⑨ extremely for the whole place when nobody else would, and ⑩ Extremely, she said in 1969, that was the part the station never forgot; the log still speaks extremely of it. She kept the switch in the same screen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the station never forgot how extremely it had been done.
